new_vertex_roles: The same two vertices each subdivide one H4 incidence and one edge of the cubic linker; the two vertices are joined. There are two additional vertices total, not four.
selection_rule: Pick first two lexicographic vertex-disjoint F edges. For each smaller endpoint, take its original H4 flag point and smallest still-unsubdivided incident line; use the same new vertex to subdivide that H4 incidence and that F edge, then join the two new vertices.
